evals.prompt: /start-task INT3-150. The Linear issue is titled 'Reserve default type' and its gitBranchName is int3-150-reserve-default-type. The agent runs inside Herdr in a repo whose origin/HEAD is master.
evals.expected_output: The branch int3-150-reserve-default-type is proposed with label INT3-150 and base master, and after confirmation the workspace is created from origin/master.
expectations: Reads the issue through the Linear connector before proposing a name.
Uses gitBranchName verbatim, without adding a type prefix.
Uses the issue ID as the workspace label.
Runs --bases and proposes master, the first line, as the base.
Waits for the user's confirmation of branch, label, and base before creating anything.
Reports branch, base, absolute worktree path, and workspace ID.

evals.prompt: /start-task fix: the rapidoochoa provider returns a null commercial discount and the price breaks
evals.expected_output: A fix/<slug> branch with a short English slug naming the defect, for example fix/rapidoochoa-discount-null.
expectations: Infers the type fix from the description.
Writes the slug in English kebab-case, 3 to 6 words.
Uses the slug as the label.
Shows the proposal and waits before creating anything.

evals.prompt: /start-task INT3-151 in a session where no Linear tools exist. The user says the title is 'Actualización de contraseña del pasajero frecuente'.
evals.expected_output: The branch is built the way Linear builds it, without accents: int3-151-actualizacion-de-contrasena-del-pasajero-frecuente.
expectations: Notices the Linear connector is missing and says so.
Builds the name from the lowercase ID plus the kebab-case title.
Strips accents and keeps the name within about 60 characters.
Does not ask the user to re-authenticate Linear.

evals.prompt: /start-task add a retry to the CDS client. HERDR_ENV is not set in this session.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops and says it is not running inside Herdr. No branch or worktree is created.
expectations: Stops when the script refuses to run outside Herdr.
Does not fall back to plain git worktree add.
Does not drive the user's Herdr session from outside it.

evals.prompt: /start-task INT3-144. The branch int3-144-reserve-default-type already exists on origin from a teammate.
evals.expected_output: The existing remote branch is checked out as a tracking branch and opened, not recreated from the base.
expectations: Runs the same script; the script picks the reopen path.
Reports that the branch already existed and was reopened.
Does not create a second branch with a different name.

evals.prompt: /start-task chore: bump eslint. Herdr answers the worktree command with a repository-trust error.
evals.expected_output: The error is shown and the user is asked before any retry with --trust-repository.
expectations: Shows Herdr's error text.
Asks before passing --trust-repository.
Does not retry with --trust-repository on its own.

evals.prompt: /start-task refactor the soap client. Should it be refactor or chore? The user also asks to start Claude in the new workspace.
evals.expected_output: The type is refactor. The workspace is created and the agent explains that starting an agent is outside this skill.
expectations: Chooses refactor for restructuring code without changing behavior.
Creates only the workspace.
Leaves the shell at the prompt and points out the user can start an agent there.

evals.prompt: /start-task INT3-152 from develop. The repo's origin/HEAD is main and the remote also has develop.
evals.expected_output: develop is used as the base without proposing main; the workspace branches off origin/develop.
expectations: Takes the base named in the request.
Skips the base proposal but still confirms branch, label, and base together.
Passes develop as the third script argument.

evals.prompt: /start-task feat: add travel assistance to rochoa checkout. When shown the base candidates (main, develop), the user answers: base it on feat/rochoa-travel-assistance, which I have not pushed yet.
evals.expected_output: The new branch stacks on the local feat/rochoa-travel-assistance; the script accepts a local-only base.
expectations: Accepts a base outside the listed candidates.
Shows the corrected proposal again before creating anything.
Does not push the parent branch to make it a remote base.
